## What this adds or corrects

One addition or correction per pull request, in plain words.

## Checklist

- [ ] Each new value has one label: Factory, Period listing, Specialist, Owner report, Maker claim, or Unconfirmed.
- [ ] Each new value names its source: a document and page, or my own measurement with model and serial.
- [ ] The source link opens a copy kept in this repository, not a live website.
- [ ] Conflicting sources are side by side, not averaged.
- [ ] Anything still unmeasured has a row in TO-CONFIRM.md.
- [ ] Nothing under `docs/originals/`, and no archived page, was changed.
